name: PM SVANidhi
full_name: Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
summary: A working capital loan for street vendors, with no collateral and an interest subsidy.
benefit_note: First loan of up to ₹15,000 repaid over 12 months. Repay on time and the next is up to ₹25,000 over 18 months, then up to ₹50,000 over 36 months. Interest subsidy of 7% a year, credited quarterly. No penalty for repaying early.
how_to_apply: If you do not have a Certificate of Vending, apply to your Urban Local Body — or to the Block Development Office if you vend in a census town or peri-urban area.
The Letter of Recommendation is issued within 15 days of applying.
Apply for the loan on the PM SVANidhi portal, or through a lending institution.
Repay the first loan on time to unlock the larger second and third loans.

curation_notes: DRAFT — not yet read by a human against the official page. Do not ship.
Taken from the official Scheme Guidelines PDF linked at https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in/Home/Schemes, downloaded and read on 2026-08-09. Every source_quote is wording from that document.

LOAN AMOUNTS ARE ₹15,000 / ₹25,000 / ₹50,000. Several widely-copied secondary sources still say ₹10,000 / ₹20,000 / ₹50,000 — those are the original 2020 figures. The current guidelines say 15/25/50. Do not 'correct' this back.
THIS IS A LOAN, NOT A GRANT. benefit_type is loan for exactly this reason — ₹15,000 borrowed must never outrank a smaller grant in the results list.

The two `any` criteria are a genuine either/or from the guidelines: a Certificate of Vending in statutory towns, or a Letter of Recommendation in census towns and peri-urban areas. This is the first scheme in the corpus to use an `any` group.

TO CONFIRM: the documents list. The guidelines describe the loan process but do not give a document checklist. vending_certificate follows from the eligibility rule and bank_passbook from the loan being credited to an account, but confirm both.

TO CONFIRM: effort_level. MEDIUM assumes the vendor already holds a certificate. Someone starting without one needs an office visit, which is HARD by our rubric. The format cannot express an effort level that depends on the user's answers — worth raising if more schemes hit this.
The scheme only applies in states that have notified rules under the Street Vendors Act 2014. Tamil Nadu's status needs checking before this ships.
